title: Produce useful retained basis-selective material changes with a broad phase-locked electron exposure.

statement.current_best: Retained direct electron-bond manipulation and feedback-driven nanoscale phase writing are measured precedents; no matched acquired Te demonstration.
statement.limitation: Acquire a same-specimen phase-,basis-,energy/angle- and dose-resolved retained-event curve with independently calibrated joint atomic/electronic trajectory,covariance and uncertainty. Include pump/electron/readout/random-phase controls,correct axial/azimuthal null scopes,retention horizon and matched direct-electron/feedback comparators. Resolve amplitude-energy compatibility and the actual legal velocity space before claiming selection. Charge source/pump/cryogenic/feedback/readout/damage costs,global terminal reward and useful throughput.
statement.problem: Produce useful retained basis-selective material changes with a broad phase-locked electron exposure.
statement.proposed_mechanism: Calibrated basis-dependent coherent momentum biases collision outcomes into a retained occupancy pattern.

target.comparator: Direct electron fabrication,real feedback writing,pump/beam/readout/random-phase controls and strongest same-specimen retained modification.
target.conditions: Same specimen,actual legal velocity/joint state/retained kernel,retention horizon and controls; no attained operating point.
target.metric: Retained basis contrast and useful yield under a declared terminal fidelity,energy and throughput target
target.unit: Verified retained modifications per electron,second and total joule
